verdict.rationale: Turso's Platform API and CLI let an AI-native user programmatically provision, token-scope, and tear down thousands or millions of isolated databases (one per user/agent/tenant), and the MCP integration lets an agent run these operations and SQL queries autonomously across many entities. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of large-scale bulk operations in practice, and no documented bulk-SQL/batch-row-operation API beyond database-level provisioning.
